title: Grilled Italian Tiramisu
description: A twist on the classic Italian dessert, adding a smoky flavor from grilled peperoncini.

ingredients.name: mixed
ingredients.notes: Combination of mascarpone and whipped cream

instructions: Grill peperoncini for 2-3 minutes on each side.
In a large mixing bowl, combine mascarpone, whipped cream, and umami paste.
Dip each ladyfinger into the coffee mixture for 3-5 seconds on each side.
In a large serving dish, create a layer of ladyfingers.
Top with a layer of mascarpone mixture and grilled peperoncini.
Repeat steps 5-6 two more times, ending with a layer of mascarpone mixture.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.
